summary: Iteration 47 — PRIMARY: Give Cover live count is fully working end-to-end for dealer Dave (dave@fourbuy.co.za). On mobile 390x844 the 'Give Cover' NavFlipTile renders a blue tinted pill badge with '1' in the top-right corner AND the dynamic hint reads exactly '1 car waiting · R10 each'. Backend confirmed: GET /api/cover/submissions returns 6 rows; exactly 1 has my_cover=null (matches badge). Admin (admin@fourbuy.co.za) does NOT see the Give Cover tile on the wide (1440) home — verified via DOM scan (Give Cover text: false). Web 3-column WeBuyCars-style grid on /cover at 1440px viewport is verified: 5 'Cover given' cards laid out at left positions 16/491/965 (row 1) then 16/491 (row 2), each card ~459×504px. Declined tab exists. On the Available tab, a red 'Decline' button + red 'Offer' button render below the card (web button flow, no gesture-handler). TakeAlot Rewards tile renders with grey/gold styling: gold REWARDS pill + gift icon + 'Fourbuy Rewards' + divider + 'POWERED BY' + takealot logo chip. Backend regression: 7 passed, 3 skipped in test_iteration_47_give_cover.py (skips = admin catalogue makes endpoint path not discoverable via probing, Dave's /api/submissions listing returned 0 rows so Deal-Tracking PATCH and Valuation-PDF byte smoke could not be reached from Dave's account — these routes were already verified in iterations 40-46). Forgot-password endpoint returns 200 for known + unknown email (correct — does not leak account existence). Reset-password with an invalid token returns 400. No new bugs. Data-drift note carried from iter46: /api/auth/me returns {"user": {...}} (not a flat user object).

minor.issue: Returns 0 rows for Dave even though he has 6 submissions surfaced via /api/cover/submissions. This is likely by design (his 'own' submissions vs cover-queue rows), but it blocked probing of Deal Tracking PATCH /api/submissions/{id}/deal and the Valuation PDF byte-stream from Dave's account in this run. Suggest seeding at least one Dave-owned submission (or exposing /api/submissions?mine=1) so future regressions can hit those flows without an admin bounce.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits several deprecation warnings on home render: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use textShadow', 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (candidates: /app/frontend/app/(app)/index.tsx styles heroWrap/coversBannerWrap/frontTitleOnImage — shadow* and textShadow*; TilePage front image — Image resizeMode style; multiple LinearGradient wrappers using pointerEvents prop instead of style.pointerEvents).

critical_code_review_comments: Give Cover badge logic in /app/frontend/app/(app)/index.tsx is guarded by isPricingAgent — correct. Loader is memoised on user.is_pricing_agent + refreshed on focus so leaving/returning updates the count without a manual refresh. Filter arr.filter(s => !s.my_cover).length exactly matches the backend's my_cover=null semantics.

quickCardBadge z-order relies on being a sibling AFTER quickIconChip inside the animated View — since the tile has overflow:hidden the badge stays inside the rounded corners. Visually reads as a proper 'unread' pill (screenshot iter47_home_dave.png).
server.py still 8500+ lines (soft-limit warning carried from prior iterations).
